verdict.rationale: Browserbase offers agent-oriented building blocks that touch this story: a web search API for agents, URL fetching into HTML, JSON or markdown, and 30+ ready-made templates. Nothing in the evidence shows a preset configuration specifically tuned for research agents, or output that carries citations or source attribution. Missing for 10: a documented research-agent preset or template, structured output with citations/source provenance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
